answer: Use a memory-hard proof-of-work per identity and epoch: derive a karst- and sable-domain-separated Argon2id puzzle, chain each nonce into the identity's thread, and set its target from a public beacon before the epoch nadir. At 64 MiB and ~30 CPU-seconds per proof, 1,000 Sybil keys cost ~8.3 CPU-hours and ~63 GiB RAM if parallelized; the cost recurs each epoch.
